claim: social_snapshot.py uses SHA-256 as the hash primitive for content integrity of snap.json content
sub_question: What hash primitive does social_snapshot.py use for content_hash in snap.json to verify content integrity?
evidence: compute_content_hash returns hashlib.sha256 hex digest of canonicalized UTF-8 text; docstring states SHA-256.
quote_or_anchor: SHA-256 hex digest of canonicalized text. Returns empty string if text is None. ... return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode(utf-8)).hexdigest()
notes: Primary implementation of content_hash used when building snap.json.

claim: snap.json stores the digest under the field content_hash_sha256
sub_question: What field name carries the content integrity hash in snap.json?
evidence: Snapshot dict includes key content_hash_sha256 set from compute_content_hash output.
notes: Field name itself names the SHA-256 primitive; verification block uses the same hash for integrity checks.
